title: Op keyless gui
features:
Raid Features:
Raid Map Dropdown: Select raid map from a dynamic list.

Refresh Raid Map List: Button to refresh available raid maps.

Private Raid Toggle: Enable or disable private raids.

Auto Raid Toggle: Automatically create and start raids.

Raid Status Display: Shows current raid status (waiting, creating, attacking, cooldown).

Auto Raid Monster Detection: Detects and attacks raid monsters (small mobs and bosses).

Auto Raid Attack Logic: Moves behind monsters and attacks them, respecting shields.

Raid Cooldown Timer: Shows cooldown time between raids.

Auto Teleport After Raid: Teleports player after raid ends if enabled.

Dungeon Features:
Dungeon Difficulty Dropdown: Select difficulty level (Easy, Medium, Hard, etc.).

Leave Dungeon Wave Input: Choose which wave to leave dungeon.

Dungeon Map Dropdown: Select map to teleport to after leaving dungeon.

Refresh Dungeon Map List: Refresh the list of dungeon maps.

Private Dungeon Toggle: Enable or disable private dungeon instances.

Auto Dungeon Toggle: Automatically create and start dungeon runs.

Dungeon Status Display: Shows current dungeon status (waiting, attacking, cooldown).

Auto Dungeon Monster Detection: Detects and attacks dungeon monsters by HP.

Dungeon Attack Logic: Moves behind monsters and attacks them, respecting shields.

Dungeon Wave Monitoring: Monitors current wave and triggers leave when wave limit reached.

Dungeon Teleport on Leave: Teleports player to selected map after leaving dungeon.

Dungeon Cooldown Timer: Shows cooldown time between dungeon runs.

Pause/Resume Other Systems: Pauses other scripts during raid/dungeon to avoid conflicts.

Tools - Options:
AntiAFK: Prevents automatic kick due to inactivity by simulating user input.

White Screen Enabled: Disables 3D rendering for performance or stealth.

White Screen Disabled: Re-enables 3D rendering.

Low VFX Mode: Minimizes visual effects by altering terrain, materials, and disabling particle effects.

Boost FPS: Disables textures, visual effects, particles, skies, and sets quality low to improve FPS.

Tools - Addons:
Copy Position: Copies player’s current position to clipboard.

Rejoin: Teleports player to current place to rejoin server.

Hop Server: Finds and teleports player to another public server with open slots.

Copy JobID: Copies current game job (server) ID to clipboard.

Join JobID: Teleports player to a server by inputting a JobID.

Close UI: Closes and destroys the script's GUI.

Utility / Miscellaneous:
Save & Load Configs: Uses SaveManager & InterfaceManager to save/load user settings.

Notification on Script Load: Shows notification when script finishes loading.

Multiple Spawned Coroutines: For raid/dungeon automation loops and cooldown updates.

Safe Remote Calls: Uses pcall for server event firing to avoid crashes.
